nodes.question: What is meant by the term "total social fact" in relation to money?
nodes.answer: The term "total social fact" characterizes money as a universal social bond with economic, political, and symbolic nature, indicating its multifaceted roles in society.
nodes.paragraph: Beyond its three func- tions as defined by Aristotle namely the role of medium of exchange, store of value and unit of account money might play a role in communication and in the creation of social bonds or signs of belonging to a society. All this is Special Purpose Money for Sustainability Handled by Paul Weaver, Maastricht University, The Netherlands. * Alexander Paulsson alexander.paulsson@fek.lu.se J r my Bouchez jeremybouchez@pm.me Marlei Pozzebon marlei.pozzebon@fgv.br 1 Pol mos D croissance, 210, 6e Rang Ouest., Saint- Val rien, QC GOL 4E0, Canada 2 FGV EAESP, Av. 9 de Julho, 2029, Bela Vista, S o Paulo, SP CEP 1313-902, Brazil 3 Lund University, PO Box 7080, 220 7 Lund, Sweden Sustainability Science counterbalanced by the fact that money is also synonymous with power relations and a mark of distinction (Les cono- mistes atterr S 2018). As a "total social fact", money can be characterised as a "universal social bond of an economic, political and symbolic nature" (Th ret and Carri , 2007, p. 38) and an "object of appropriation, control and therefore power" (Aglietta and Orl an 1998, p. 38) that is based on hierarchical trust, as there is a third-party rule setter who protects and regulates, thus ensuring social cohesion (Fare 2016).

nodes.question: What is suggested about the relationship between money and power?
nodes.answer: Money is synonymous with power relations and is considered a mark of distinction, highlighting its role in societal hierarchies and control.
